title: Same projection, different workload shape
purpose: Contrast implemented one-token GEMV with a derived multi-token matrix product.
contract: Our operator accepts one [D] vector only. Sequence GEMM is conceptual here.
A token/head permutation changes strides; metadata reshape is not a transpose.
